result:
Build is clean. That completes the fix set. Here's the summary.

## What was wrong

GSC showed a classic brand-pivot mismatch: the product moved from "Lumina" (AI meeting assistant) to "InboxZap" (inbox cleanup tool). Branded searches (`inboxzap`, `inboxzap app`) ranked fine. Every non-branded, high-intent query matching the *actual* product (`inbox zero`, `bulk delete emails`, `gmail storage full`, `unsubscribe newsletters`, etc.) got 300–1900 impressions but ranked position 38–65 with near-zero clicks — despite the 12 blog posts already having genuinely good, correctly-targeted content.

Root causes, all structural:
- Blog index fetched posts from a non-existent `/api/posts` client-side — the 12 posts had **zero internal links** pointing to them anywhere on the site.
- `sitemap.ts` explicitly excluded blog posts (`// TODO: include blog posts once...`).
- No meta description on any blog post.
- Site-wide brand incoherence: nav, footer, and JSON-LD still said "Lumina / AI meeting assistant" on every page while the blog talked about email cleanup.
- `/faq` had been collapsed into a redirect to `/#faq` that didn't exist, 404ing live — exactly the page that should rank for the question-shaped queries in GSC.
- `/features` and `/pricing` were linked in nav/sitemap but had no source files.

## What I fixed

- `app/blog/posts.ts` — extracted all 12 posts into real content data.
- `app/blog/page.tsx` — server-rendered index, actually links to every post.
- `app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx` — real route per post, unique title/description/canonical/OG, `BlogPosting` JSON-LD, internal links back to blog + pricing.
- `app/sitemap.ts` — now includes all 12 posts, `/faq`.
- `app/layout.tsx`, `app/page.tsx` — rebranded to InboxZap throughout; homepage copy now matches the actual product; `Organization`/`SoftwareApplication` JSON-LD.
- `app/faq/page.tsx` — new dedicated page targeting the question-shaped queries (no `FAQPage` schema — Google restricted FAQ rich results to gov/health sites in 2023, so I left it as plain content).
- `app/features/page.tsx`, `app/pricing/page.tsx` — stubbed so nav/sitemap links aren't broken.
- `next.config.js` — removed the dead `/faq → /#faq` redirect.

Verified with a full `next build` + local `next start`: all 12 posts statically generate, the blog index links to all of them, `/faq` returns 200, sitemap lists all 17 URLs, and every page now consistently says InboxZap.
